title: CPSC, Pokémon USA Announce Recall of Pokémon Plush Toys
summary: The stuffing of the toy may contain tips of sewing needles, which could pose a puncture hazard. Units: About 9,200.

title: CPSC, Graco Children's Products Inc. Announce Recall of Duo Tandem and Certain MetroLite™ Strollers
summary: These strollers can fail to latch properly and unexpectedly collapse while in use. This can result in broken bones, cuts, bumps, bruises and other injuries to young children riding in the stroller and consumers pushing the stroller. Units: About 1 million Duo Tandem and about 143,000 MetroLite strol

title: CPSC, Dorel Juvenile Group Issue Alert on Safety 1st Tubside Bath Seats
summary: The bath seats are not intended and should not be used with certain non-traditional or sunken bathtubs. In these types of tubs, the bath seat can break, tip over and a child can fall into the water. Units: About 250,000.

title: CPSC, Rolf Prima Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Wheels
summary: The rear wheel freehub mechanism can malfunction, causing no resistance when pedaling. The bicycle rider could lose balance, fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 870.

title: CPSC, Tecumseh Power Co. Announce Recall to Repair Lawn Tractors
summary: The axles on these lawn tractors can crack and break, if subject to extreme load amounts. Should the axle break, it could cause a loss of control and result in injuries to the rider. Units: About 21,000.

title: CPSC, Club Car Announce Recall of Golf Cars
summary: The accelerator pedal can temporarily stick when depressed, resulting in unexpected acceleration or difficulty braking. Units: 71,700 golf cars.

title: CPSC, HiPer Technology Inc. Announce Recall of ATV Wheels
summary: The aluminum center section of the wheel can come apart, causing the tire and rim to unexpectedly separate from the ATV, posing a risk of serious injury if the rider loses control of the vehicle. Units: About 875.

title: CPSC, Nautilus Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Exercise Benches
summary: A weld on the bench frame, under the seat, can crack and separate from the main frame, allowing the bench to collapse and the user to fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, Two's Company Inc. Announce Recall of Shell Candles
summary: The candles can burn at an excessive height or cause the outer shell to catch fire, posing a potential fire and burn hazard. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, Lamplight Farms Inc. Announce Recall of Tiki® Cone Metal Torches Sold at Wal-Mart
summary: The head and cover of these torches can come loose or be dislodged during use, allowing torch fuel to spill. This poses a risk of burn injuries and property damage. Units: About 350,000.

title: CPSC, Target Announce Recall of Children's Toy Trucks
summary: Small parts could break off the truck, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 17,400.

title: CPSC, Sycamore Kids Inc. Announce Recall of Mountain Buggy Jogging Strollers
summary: The handlebar can crack or break, causing the handlebar to possibly detach while in use, posing a risk of injury to young children. Units: About 300.

title: CPSC, BJ Alan Co. Announce Recall of "Blaster Balls" Fireworks
summary: When the blaster balls are hit together, they can produce a spark that can catch on fire, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 6,600.

title: CPSC, BJ Alan Co. Announce Recall of Mammoth Smoke Fountain Fireworks
summary: The device can unexpectedly propel on the ground or unintentionally explode during use, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: CPSC, Value City Announce Recall of Blow Dart Guns
summary: Consumers may have mistakenly purchased the dart guns, thinking it was a decorative walking stick, posing the risk of injury, if someone used the gun for its intended purpose. Units: About 300.

title: CPSC, NBTY Inc. Announce Recall of Multivitamins
summary: The vitamins contain iron, but do not have child-resistant packaging, as required by federal law. They could cause serious injury or death if ingested by a child. Units: About 12,000 bottles.

title: CPSC, Perm-a-Store Announce Recall of Inprint™ Safe-Boxes for Handguns
summary: The door on these safe-boxes may not latch properly when closed, possibly giving children and others unauthorized access to a firearm. Units: 500.

title: CPSC, The Holmes Group Expands Recall of Slow Cookers
summary: The handles on the base of the slow cookers can break, posing a risk of burns from hot contents spilling onto consumers. title: CPSC, American Suzuki Motor Corp. Announce Recall of ATVs
summary: A significant impact to the front wheel of the ATV, while the steering is fully turned to either side, can result in suspension damage, wear, and an eventual loss of steering control, that could result in injury or death. Units: About 3,400.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Announce Recall of 900 Fusion, 900 RMK, and 900 Switchback Snowmobiles
summary: There are three separate issues involved in this safety recall: Front Suspension Spindle - The nut that fastens the upper control arm ball joint to the suspension spindle can loosen. title: CPSC, Sportcraft Announce Recall of Treadmills
summary: The treadmill can unexpectedly accelerate and cause users to fall and sustain injuries. Units: About 12,000.

title: CPSC, Fourstar Group Announce Recall to Repair Kid's Folding Chairs
summary: The chair's safety lock can fail, allowing the chair to collapse or fold unexpectedly. title: CPSC, Meco Corp. Announce Recall of Children's Folding Chairs
summary: Children's fingers can become caught or entrapped in the hinge and slot areas of the chair, posing a pinch or cut hazard. title: CPSC, H&M Announce Recall of Baby Denim and Knit Jackets
summary: The metal buttons can come loose and detach from these garments, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 750.

title: CPSC, Kidde Announce Recall of Industrial Fire Extinguishers
summary: The nylon valves on these extinguishers can separate from the steel cylinder during the 6-year recharge service or shortly afterwards, creating a safety hazard to fire extinguisher service personnel and consumers. Units: About 470,000.

title: CPSC, Radio Flyer Inc. Announce Recall of Toddler Walker Wagon
summary: The tips of the clickers, which make a clicking sound when the Walker Wagon wheels move, can break off. The broken clickers pose a choking or aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 38,000.

title: CPSC, VisionTech USA, Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycle Aero Bars
summary: The centerpiece of these bicycle aero bars can crack or break, causing the bicycle rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 280.
